description: Validates a caller-supplied payload against the AINumbers Unified Build Contract v1.0 Policy Mandate field set (ap2_version, mandate_id, tool_id, mandate_type, jurisdiction, audit_metadata, and related fields), scoring compliance 0-100 and flagging deprecated fields. Stage 3 of the Agentic Policy Chain. Deterministic, zero PII, no external network calls.
deferred_reason: New node landed by ORPHANNODE-ONBOARD-2 as a disjoint shard: the zkVM receipt is generated by the asynchronous GPU proving queue after the shard is folded into chaingraph.json by ASSEMBLE-LAND, because the guest cannot be built against a kernel that is not yet in the assembled monolith. The kernel is fully deterministic and its sha256-source identity is published above, so the proof can be attached without any hash-moving edit.
